resources.string: Scan this code on another device to open the short URL. Generated on this device without contacting the server. Scanning and opening the link may count as a visit.
Cannot generate a QR code: the short URL is not a valid HTTP or HTTPS address.
Could not encode this short URL as a QR code. It may be too long.
This window is too small to display the complete QR code. Rotate your device or enlarge the window.
Redirect rule management is planned for an upcoming test version.

Day periods include today, starting at midnight in your device time zone. Refresh updates the end time. Counts come from two server queries for the same period; concurrent changes may affect them. Potential bot visits = total minus non-bot visits, based on Shlink’s classification. Only this shlink’s recorded visits are included, not orphan visits. No individual visitors are displayed or stored by the app. Loading statistics does not visit the short URL.
The server returned missing, invalid or inconsistent visit counts. Refresh to try again; no zero values were assumed.
Could not load visit statistics. Check your connection and try again.
Permanently delete this shlink and its visit history from the server? The short URL will stop working. This cannot be undone.
Shlink refused deletion because this link exceeds the server’s visit threshold. The app will not bypass that protection.
Deletion could not be confirmed. The shlink may already be deleted. Reload the details before trying again; no automatic retry was made.
The server reports that this shlink does not exist or is not accessible for this domain. Reload the details or go back to the refreshed list.
Could not load tag suggestions. Check your connection and API key permissions. You can still enter tags manually.
No existing tags available. You can enter new tags above.
No other matching suggestions. You can enter new tags above.
Up to 8 suggestions. Type in the tag field to narrow them down; tap a suggestion to add it.
Total includes bot visits and corresponds to the visit count used for sorting.
Dates are shown as supplied by Shlink, including their time zone when provided.
This indicates whether rules exist. Displaying and editing individual redirect rules will follow later.
Editing an existing shlink. Its short URL, code and domain stay unchanged. Only changed fields are sent; app defaults and the automatic app tag are not applied.

Tap the date to open the calendar, or the time to open the clock. For an empty limit, choosing a date starts at 00:00; choosing a time uses today. Clear removes the limit. The end must be after the start.
This local time does not exist due to a daylight-saving change. Choose another time.
The end must be after the start. Adjust the highlighted date.
Leave empty for no visit limit. Otherwise enter a whole number greater than zero.
Allow search engines to crawl this short URL via Shlink’s robots.txt.
Append query parameters from the short URL to the destination URL. No prevents this forwarding.
The server did not provide this value. Leave unselected to keep it unchanged.
Enter valid dates with time zones. The end must be after the start.
Enter a whole number greater than zero, or leave empty for no limit.
Shlink rejected the changes. Check the fields and API key permissions.
The result could not be confirmed. Changes may already be saved. Reload the details before editing or saving again.
Your unsaved edits will be discarded. The shlink will not be changed.
This shlink no longer exists or is not accessible for this domain.
The server did not return valid shlink details.
Could not load shlink details. Check your connection and server profile, then try again.
Enter a destination URL. Leave optional fields blank to use Shlink defaults.
New shlink defaults — Forward query parameters: %1$s; Crawlable: %2$s. Change these in Settings.
Hostname only, e.g. s.example.org. Leave blank for the default domain. Your API key must allow this domain.
Press Enter to add a tag. Commas also work, including when pasting. Tap a tag to remove it.
App tag: %1$s — added automatically. Change or disable it in Settings.
Enter a full HTTP or HTTPS destination URL without embedded credentials.
Enter a hostname without protocol, port or path.
Could not read the server profile, API key or app settings. Please try again.
This server profile no longer exists. Go back and select another server.
Shlink rejected the input. Check the destination URL, custom slug, domain and API key permissions.
This custom slug is already in use for this domain. Choose another slug.
Shlink could not complete the request. Check the list before trying again.
The result could not be confirmed. The shlink may already have been created. Go back and check the refreshed list before trying again.
Could not save the sort order. Your previous order is still selected. Please try again.
No shlinks on this server yet.
No active server. Please select a server.
This shlink is not a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL and cannot be opened.
No browser is available to open this shlink.
No app is available to share this shlink.
Android did not allow this action. Please check your device restrictions.
The API key is missing or cannot be decrypted. Edit the server profile and enter its API key again.
The API key is invalid or does not have the required permissions.
The server did not return a valid shlink list.
The server hostname could not be resolved. Check your network, DNS and server address.
The server cannot be reached. Check your network, VPN and server.
Loading timed out. Please try again.
The TLS certificate could not be verified. Check the certificate, server address and device time.
The server returned HTTP %1$d. Shlinks could not be loaded.
Shlinks could not be loaded. Please try again.
